post.summary: Explain the change of a Measure between one time bucket and the bucket before it
post.description: BI-INSIGHTS-1 P2 (I-4, I-5, I-6), Business Insights add-on. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. Every statement runs through the gates of POST /bi/query as the caller (dataset visibility, SQL guard, sandbox, masking): a classified dimension value comes back as its alias. Body: dataset, optional filters / when, exactly one of measure {agg, field} or ratio {num, den} (sum or count only - a non-additive aggregate is refused in words), field (date column), grain (day | week | month), at (a date inside the bucket to explain), dimensions (1-12), optional cover (0.5-1, default 0.8), related (0-10 Measures) and lookback (8-60 buckets, default 24). drivers: per dimension the contribution, share of the change and Jensen-Shannon surprise of each value, and the fewest values covering cover x the change; ranked. mixRate (ratio only): the exact shift-share split mix + rate = change. movedWith: correlation of the bucket-to-bucket changes, at least 8 pairs; never a cause. A dimension with more than 200 values is listed in refused. Pairs of dimensions (depth 2) are not offered.

200.description: Envelope-wrapped: data = {measure, kind (additive | ratio), grain, previous, current, before, after, delta, pct, cover, drivers[{dimension, explains, covered, surprise, cover[], elements[{value, before, after, contribution, share, surprise}] (top 20), valueCount}], mixRate[{dimension, before, after, mix, rate, parts[{value, w0, w1, r0, r1, mix, rate}]}] (ratio only), refused[{dimension, reason}], movedWith[{measure, before, after, pairs, r, movedWith, reason?}], movedWithNote, masking?}

404.description: The dataset is unknown or not visible to the caller.

422.description: A bad body, a non-additive aggregate, no value in one of the two buckets, a Measure the caller sees masked, or a failed statement.

503.description: No Space write root, or the Business Insights module is not installed.
